visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit gym with industrial decor, a woman wearing a white Adidas sports bra and green leggings argues with a man possessing an afro hairstyle. She points her finger angrily while he looks downcast in a blue Vegeta tank top. (2) The scene shifts to a montage of the man working out intensely, performing bicep curls and lat pulldowns with a strained facial expression. The lighting becomes high-contrast and cinematic as he exerts himself. (3) Years later, the man is shown with a much larger, more muscular physique in a black tank top. A bearded muscular coach in a black sleeveless shirt smiles and inspects the man's arms near gym racks. (4) The man approaches a second woman in a black t-shirt, flexing his muscles; she appears bored and dismissive, shaking her head. They are standing in the middle of the gym aisle under bright artificial lighting. (5) Distraught, the man sits on gym equipment with his head in his hands. The coach returns to comfort him with a hand on his shoulder, and they both eventually transition to a squat machine to train together.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male lead, 2 female roles, 1 male coach, and several background gym-goers.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male fitness enthusiast with a large afro, progressing from a slim build to a highly muscular physique, often wearing gym tank tops.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A professional gym environment featuring weight machines, mirrors, and industrial lighting tracks on the ceiling.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, high-pitched female voice shouts angrily in Traditional Chinese against a background of gym room tone and a low-intensity bass synth. (2) A loud 'whoosh' sound effect triggers the start of a driving Phonk track with heavy 808 beats. A male voice shouts with extreme strain and high arousal. (3) The music volume ducks for a conversational interlude between two male voices; one is deep and encouraging, while the other is hesitant. (4) Another digital transition SFX introduces a calm but dismissive female voice as the Phonk music resumes. The male lead speaks with a high-pitched, panicked inflection. (5) The track concludes with an upbeat electronic rhythm as the two male friends shout enthusiastically, accompanying the sounds of weights being moved.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Rejection -> Transformation -> New Reality -> Comedic Twist -> Bromance
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic sketch subverting the gym transformation trope. It demonstrates that while bodybuilding can provide personal growth and male bonding, it doesn't automatically solve relationship issues or make one universally attractive, emphasizing humor over typical fitness inspiration.
